title: Generate native 30-second videos in a single Seedance 2.5 run for long-take…
content:
Generate native 30-second videos in a single Seedance 2.5 run for long-take shots.  
Use Long Video Mode to extend outputs up to 3 minutes while maintaining consistency across the full clip.  
Use precise timestamp control (down to 1-second granularity) to target and edit specific moments in the video.  
Use the interactive editing tools to reshape/edit any part of the frame after generation.  
Provide up to 50 multimodal references to steer generation, including 3D white models and green-screen footage when available.  
Integrate Seedance 2.5 into film/VFX workflows via the Dreamina AI plugins for Maya and Blender.
